calls.statement:
SELECT format, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores, min(store_id) AS min_id, max(store_id) AS max_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)) AS stores_with_format_change,
 (SELECT fiscal_period_label||' '||min(calendar_date)||' '||max(calendar_date)||' '||max(is_trading_day::int) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4 GROUP BY fiscal_period_label) AS p4
FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids,
 count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)) AS receipts_multi_store_or_date,
 sum((net_amount<=0)::int) AS nonpositive_lines, min(sale_date), max(sale_date),
 (SELECT fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) AS loaded
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

calls.statement:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, cs.format, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT format, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS all_receipts, sum(net_amount) AS all_net,
    count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS rcpt,
    sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS net
  FROM src GROUP BY 1
), ctl AS (
  SELECT cs.format, sum(r.receipts) AS ctl_receipts, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.format, all_receipts, ctl_receipts, all_net, ctl_net, rcpt, net, round(net/rcpt,2) AS atv, round(all_net/all_receipts,2) AS atv_incl_staff
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (format) ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) AS mixed_staff_receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category='ZZ Test') AS zz_lines_in_stores,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id=999) AS lines_999

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period)
SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period, cs.format,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 3
